coal.name: Cast-iron Boiler
coal.desc: High pollution, high output. Place on a house to heat it.

pellet.name: Steel Boiler (1917–1928)
pellet.desc: More durable, heats faster, lower fuel consumption.

gas.name: Triola Boiler (1957)
gas.desc: Steel boiler with preheater. Conversion from coke to oil.

stainless1972.name: First Stainless Boiler (1972)
stainless1972.desc: Lighter and more efficient; precursor to condensing.

vitola1978.name: Low-temperature Vitola Boiler (1978)
vitola1978.desc: Operates at lower water temps (better efficiency).

vitodens1989.name: Vitodens Gas Boiler (1989)
vitodens1989.desc: Steam condensing, higher efficiency, lower emissions.

heatpump.name: Heat Pump (Vitocal)
heatpump.desc: High efficiency and renewables. Unlocks green installs.

forest.name: Forest
forest.desc: Strongly reduces pollution (−0.5/s). Each additional is more expensive.

lab.name: R&D Laboratory
lab.desc: Permanently increases resource production (+0.02 ☀️/💧/🌬️, +0.01 💰). Only one – very expensive.
